item.title: Mchunu to contest Witness E's allegations at Madlanga Inquiry
item.description: Witness E told the Madlanga Commission that suspected police minister Senzo Mchunu personally tried to coach him into lying under oath to the commission.

item.title: Enterprise development is not flowing where it should
item.description: Much of ESD activity is framed around compliance, with corporates ticking boxes to satisfy B-BBEE requirements.

item.title: CSA claps back, Ottneil Baartman was kept in the loop
item.description: Cricket SA’s Patrick Moroney disputes Ottneil Baartman’s (pictured left) claim of not being informed about his omission from the Proteas T20 World Cup squad, stating he was indeed contacted, leaving the truth of the matter unclear. Picture: AFP

item.title: MISA urges balanced approach as Chinese, Indian brands reshape SA auto sector
item.description: This comes as the government is currently debating whether to impose higher tariffs of up to 50% on imported cars from India and China as local manufacturers struggle to compete and protect jobs in the domestic automotive industry.

item.title: SA farmers demand the right to privately vaccinate against Foot and Mouth Disease
item.description: As the threat of Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) continues, Minister of Agriculture John Steenhuisen has called for unity amid a threat of legal action against the department.

item.title: LaConco opens up about her emotional journey as the new ‘Utatakho’ host
item.description: Award-winning TV Presenter and reality star, Nonkanyiso 'Laconco' Conco, is the new face of Mzansi Magic's 'Utatakho'.

item.title: Clients shocked as questions raised over Interpol Red Notice linked to Virgin Active trainer
item.description: Clients at a Constantia gym say they are in disbelief after reports linked a popular personal trainer to an Interpol alert. Authorities have not confirmed his identity.

item.title: South Africa's auto industry calls on government to address fundamental challenges
item.description: Naamsa has called on Government to refine existing policies rather than radical overhauls to secure the industry's future.

item.title: 2019 Rugby World Cup losing finalist Anthony Watson - Springboks were in a better emotional state
item.description: South Africa's centre Damian De Allende (R) tackles England's wing Anthony Watson during the Japan 2019 Rugby World Cup final match between England and South Africa at the International Stadium Yokohama in Yokohama on November 2, 2019. Picture: Odd Andersen / AFP

item.title: Is Clement Maosa leaving 'Skeem Saam'? Fans speculate after actor's heartfelt Instagram post
item.description: Clement Maosa's recent post on Instagram left fans confused and wondering if he is bidding farewell to his beloved character on &quot;Skeem Saam.&quot;
